subject: general
question: Which year among the following did India host the Commonwealth Games?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 2010**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India hosted the** Commonwealth Games** in** New Delhi** from **3 to 14 October 2010.**
 
• It was officially known as the **XIX(19th) Commonwealth Games**.
 
• The **Motto **was** "Come out and play".**
 
• The ceremony was opened by **Charles, Prince of Wales** and **Pratibha Patil, President of India.**
 
• A total of 4352 athletes from **71 Commonwealth nations** and dependencies competed in 21 sports and 272 events.
 
• **India **held the **3rd place** with **101 medals**( **38 Golds**, **27 Silvers **and** 36 Bronze**). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Commonwealth Games**:

 
• **The Commonwealth Games** is a multi-sport event **held every four years** among athletes from countries that are **members of the Commonwealth of Nations**, most of which are territories that were **once part of the British Empire.**
